# Project Instructions
- Stack: React (Vite), TypeScript (Strict), Tailwind CSS, Lucide React.
- Structure: Pages in `src/pages/`, components in `src/components/`, mock data and utils in `src/utils/`.
- UI & Style: Keep designs responsive and mobile-friendly; use clean Tailwind utility classes.
- Localization: UI text must be Traditional Chinese (zh-TW, e.g., 使用者, 專案, 建立).
- Code Quality: Prefer clean functional components and explicit TypeScript types over `any`.
- Logic & State: Store local state in custom hooks (`src/hooks/`); simulate API calls with mock functions.
- Git Commits: Use standard prefix format (`feat:`, `fix:`, `style:`, `docs:`).
- Safety: No external secret keys allowed in raw code.
